agentCapabilities.note: Antigravity is a full peer of Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode as an agent. The wrapper modeling reflects OBSERVABILITY only.

whyWrapper: No --json, --output-format, --stream or --jsonl flag exists in 1.1.5 or 1.1.6.
--print emits prose intended for a terminal, so there is no machine-readable event stream to normalize.
GitCron refuses to apply regex to prose or ANSI output, so events and usage stay unknown.

unexplored.note: Enable remote control mode. Not documented in --help beyond this line. If it carries a structured protocol, agy could become a first-class adapter instead of a lifecycle wrapper. Tracked in docs/02_ROADMAP.md.
